caseNameFull: John C. Orrell, in Error v. The Bay Manufacturing Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Mississippi.
attorneys: Mr. E. M. Barber, Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. Wayne MacVeagh, Mr. J. S. Flannery and Mr. William Hitz for plaintiffs in error., Mr. E.. J. Bowers for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, on the authority of Schlosser v. Hemphill, 198 U. S. 173.
